c109.title: A Day on Set
c109.story: Sofia went to a [[casting]] and got a small role as an extra. On her first day, she met the young [[filmmaker]] and the [[production designer]]. The [[cameraman]] asked her to stand still for a [[close-up]] of her face. Between scenes, the [[narrator]] explained the [[setting]]: a small town in the 1960s. Sofia's scene was a [[flashback]] to the main character's childhood. In the evening, the director showed the team a short [[preview]]. The [[footage]] was full of [[suspense]], and the [[soundtrack]] was beautiful. Then Sofia laughed: the director had a tiny [[cameo]] as a bus driver beside her.

c110.title: Grandpa's Old Films
c110.story: On Sunday, Grandpa told Anna about the old [[drive-in]] near his village. Before that, he and Grandma often went to shows at the [[music hall]] downtown. His favorite movies are classic [[noir]], but Grandma always loved a good [[melodrama]]. "I never liked the [[mainstream]]," Grandpa said. "I prefer [[indie]]." He put a [[disc]] into the old player, and they watched a [[remake]] of a detective movie. "It's a nice [[homage]] to the original," he said. Later, Anna found an old [[photo album]] and a box of [[negatives|negative]]. She scanned them and made a [[slide show]] for the whole family. When Grandpa saw it, his eyes were full of [[nostalgia]].

c111.title: Taras's Anime Heroes
c111.story: Taras watches [[anime]] every night after dinner. His favorite hero is a shy boy at school. But his [[alter ego]] is strong and fast, like a [[superman]]. His only weakness is cold water. It is his [[kryptonite]]. The villain is a cold [[sociopath]] with many [[minions|minion]]. He also has a [[droid]] and an angry [[ogre]]. They all live in a [[creepy]] castle with an old [[vampire]]. The vampire is funny, and the ogre is not a [[cannibal]]. He only eats soup! Before bed, Taras reads a book about a [[hobbit]]. It is a long [[saga]], and he loves every page. Tonight he falls asleep with the book on his face.

c112.title: Taras the Gamer
c112.story: Taras is a real [[gamer]]. [[Gaming|gaming]] is his favorite hobby. On Saturday, he turns on his [[console]] and takes his new [[controller]]. He joins his online [[squad]]. Soon he finds a rare [[item]] and makes a ten-hit [[combo]]. Then the screen freezes. "[[Lag|lag]] again!" he shouts. Dad checks the router and finds a problem with the [[IP]] address. The game restarts, and Taras loses his new [[high score]]. Dad smiles. "Next time, buy faster internet, not a new [[add-on]]."

c113.title: Max Makes a Game
c113.story: Max and his friend Oleh dream of becoming [[game developers|game developer]]. This year, they finally start their own small project. Max's cousin Ira joins as [[project manager]], and a classmate joins as one more [[dev]]. Together they make an [[RPG]] about a magic forest. The hero is a brave [[elf]] who fights an [[orc]] and a sneaky [[goblin]]. On the way, she meets an old [[mage]] who has no [[mana]] left. The [[gameplay]] is simple, but their friends love it. Players can even add a [[mod]] and choose their own [[avatar]]. After a month, a hundred people download the game, and Ira orders pizza for everyone.

c114.title: Uncle's Poker Night
c114.story: Max's uncle Petro invites his friends for a [[poker]] night. They play with plastic chips and a big bowl of peanuts. Uncle Petro tries a big [[bluff]] and goes [[all-in]]. But his neighbor calmly shows a [[full house]]. "You're a real [[hustler]]!" Uncle Petro laughs and hands over all his chips. Then he tells long stories about a [[casino]] trip many years ago. He played [[blackjack]] all night and lost everything. "[[Gambling|gambling]] is not for me anymore," he says. "I never won a [[jackpot]], not once." Grandma shakes her head. "You're a [[gambler]], Petro. Play [[pinball]] instead!"

c115.title: Anna's Travel Blog
c115.story: Anna starts a travel [[blog]] on the [[web]]. First, she writes a short [[bio]] about herself. Her first [[post]] is about a weekend in Lviv. She adds a [[hashtag]], a sun [[emoji]] and a funny [[gif]]. Max lends her his [[tripod]], and she films a short [[video clip]]. She works on her [[content]] every evening. She answers every [[comment]], even the short ones. After two months, [[blogging]] brings her a hundred [[followers|follower]]. Max smiles. "Now you're a real [[blogger]]!"

c116.title: Max's Cat Goes Viral
c116.story: Max films a funny [[video]] of his cat, Bublyk. He drags the clip onto the [[timeline]] and adds music. The next day, it is a [[meme]]. Soon it is a [[trend]] in the whole city. People add a [[tag]] with the cat's name. His classmate writes a [[tweet]] about it. The [[hype]] grows every day. A pet shop offers a [[giveaway]] for his fans. Then Max posts a [[how-to]] about a kitchen [[hack]] for cat owners. He also makes a [[playlist]] of songs for cat lovers. Bublyk does not care. He just sleeps on the keyboard.

c117.title: Trouble in the Comments
c117.story: One evening, a [[troll]] wrote rude comments under Anna's post about Kyiv. Then he sent her a friend [[request]], which was very strange. Anna wrote to the [[moderator]] of the travel [[forum]]. She quickly stopped the [[trolling]] and deleted all the [[hate speech]]. The whole online [[community]] supported Anna. Then the rude user said that the Kyiv metro was closed for a year. People asked him for [[proof]] and real [[info]]. Of course, he had none, because it was just [[fake news]]. He disappeared that night, and Anna went back to planning her next trip.

c118.title: Anna's Podcast
c118.story: Anna and Max start a [[podcast]] about student life in Kyiv. Max writes a short, happy [[jingle]] for the start. They record the [[audio]] on an old [[recorder]]. In the evening, Anna edits the [[audio file]] on her laptop. They also print a small [[booklet]] about the show. Every week they practice [[storytelling]] with funny stories from class. One day, a [[reporter]] from a local [[radio]] station calls them. She wants an [[interview]] with them on her [[radio show]]. Max is nervous, but Anna says, "Just tell a good story!"

c119.title: Meeting a Superstar
c119.story: Sofia is a [[finalist]] in a TV [[talent show]]. After her song, a talent [[scout]] from [[showbiz]] gives her a card. Backstage, she meets a famous [[superstar]]. He is a rich [[playboy]] with a big [[bodyguard]]. [[VIP]] guests talk about [[glamour]] and fast cars. Outside, the [[paparazzi]] take hundreds of photos. Then girls from her school [[fan club]] run to Sofia. They ask for her [[autograph]], not his!

c120.title: A Day at the Zoo
c120.story: On Saturday, Anna takes her little brother Taras to the zoo. First, they see a big [[tiger]] and a quiet [[gorilla]]. A mother [[orangutan]] holds her baby. The [[panda]] eats bamboo, and a [[zebra]] runs in the sun. A [[leopard]] sleeps on a high branch. In the river, a [[crocodile]] opens its huge mouth. Taras hides behind Anna when he sees the [[python]]. Next, they watch pink [[flamingos|flamingo]] and funny [[lemurs|lemur]]. A guide explains each animal's natural [[habitat]]. At the end, they are very hungry. They buy hot dogs at the [[snack bar]].
